title: Tabular Data
description: Tabular payload (columns + rows) for a data app. A common IntentResult of `GetAppData` when the offer’s `contextType` is `fdc3.data.tabularData` (other offers may return other FDC3 context types). Also used as the context for `fdc3.open` / `ViewData` (seed or replace-in-place). Optionally embeds a standard `fdc3.chart` when the consumer should display the same data as a chart. Prefer targeted intents over user-channel broadcast.

instanceId.title: Instance ID
instanceId.description: Optional instance this payload came from or should replace.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Row values. Each row is an array of cell values aligned with `columns`.

chart.title: Chart
chart.description: Optional embedded [`fdc3.chart`](https://fdc3.finos.org/docs/next/context/Chart) context. When present, the consumer MAY render this tabular payload as a chart using the chart’s style / range / instruments (and `otherConfig`) rather than as a plain table. The authoritative cell data remains in `columns` / `rows`.
